title: Fulfillment Release Standard for Blood Glucose Testing Supply Refills
content:
A refill on the Blood Glucose Testing Supply Program is released from the distribution center only when every condition below holds.

**R1 — Program status.** A refill ships only while the program is active; a program in referral received, pending authorization, on hold or closed receives no refill.

**R2 — Authorization drawn.** Each refill draws on one authorization grant of the program, recorded on the shipment, and the ship date must be on or before the valid-through date on the authorization being drawn.

**R3 — Units remaining.** The units shipped may not exceed the program's authorized units remaining.

**R4 — Supply days (no longer in force for test-strip refills).** The clause "the supply days of a shipment are the tier's supply days per shipment, shortened to the whole 30-day blocks that remain before the authorization's valid-through date when fewer remain; the units and pieces follow from the supply days under the quantity limits" is no longer in force for a test-strip refill whose supply days and units are fixed under the current test-strip refill quantity basis; every other refill keeps this clause and the units of the quantity limits.

**R5 — Customer confirmation.** On tiers where refill confirmation is required, the refill ships only after the customer personally confirms, for this shipment, that they are still using the item and how much supply they have on hand; the confirmation date is recorded on the shipment, Larkfield never ships those tiers automatically, and Larkfield's own refill reminder for those tiers is made no sooner than the tier's refill reminder lead, in calendar days before the planned ship date. On the self-pay tier refills ship on the subscription schedule without a per-shipment confirmation. The confirmation is the customer's own statement in the contact.

**R6 — Not too early.** The next refill of the same item ships no earlier than the tier's refill ship lead, in calendar days before the end of the supply of the previous refill shipment of that item, counted in calendar days: the previous refill's ship date plus its supply days gives the end of its supply, the earliest permitted ship date is the lead days before that end date, and shipping on that earliest date is allowed. A replacement shipment never counts as the previous refill.

**R7 — Coverage verification.** The coverage record the program bills must have been verified with the payer within the tier's re-verification period, in calendar months before the ship date, as shown by the coverage record's last verified date; the self-pay tier has no coverage to verify.

**R8 — Shipping charges.** Standard ground shipping is free on insured tiers; on the self-pay tier standard shipping costs the tier's standard shipping fee, posted as a patient charge, unless the shipment's cash-price total reaches the free-shipping threshold. Expedited shipping is provided on the customer's request for the expedited fee, posted as a patient charge because no payer covers delivery speed, and is recorded as expedited at no charge when the expedite only makes up for a delay Larkfield caused.

**R9 — Billing.** A refill on a payer tier is billed to the payer by claim with the ship date as the date of service; a refill on the self-pay tier is charged to the customer at the Larkfield cash price.

**R10 — Inpatient stays.** On tiers where shipments are held during an inpatient stay, nothing ships while the customer is an inpatient in a hospital or skilled nursing facility; the program is held under the program hold rules.

**Earliest ship date, both sides (hypothetical).** The earliest ship date lies the supply days less the lead days after the previous refill's ship date. A previous refill of 90 days shipped on day 0, with a 10-day lead, makes day 80 the earliest ship date: shipping on day 80 is allowed, shipping on day 79 is not. A 30-day refill with a 7-day lead gives day 23.

**Re-verification, both sides (hypothetical).** With a 12-month period and a ship date of 10 May, a last verified date of 10 May of the previous year is within the period; 9 May of the previous year is not.
